test.create_query: CREATE TABLE group_by_uint8_key (k UInt8, s UInt8, v UInt32) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO group_by_uint8_key SELECT intHash32(number) % 16, intDiv(number, 100000) % 256, toUInt32(number) FROM numbers_mt(160000000)
test.query: SELECT k, sum(v) FROM group_by_uint8_key GROUP BY k FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
